agents.name: implementer
agents.prompt: Read docs/feature.md and inspect the application and tests/ui.acceptance.mjs. Implement the requested UI change. Do not modify the protected specification, dependency manifests, or acceptance test. Run the actual Chromium test using python3 /opt/pi-lab/with-http-server.py --port 4173 -- node tests/ui.acceptance.mjs. The test must already use TEST_BASE_URL and a Linux-compatible executablePath. /opt/pi-lab/browser-options.mjs is available. Save screenshots under .pi-lab. If the app requires a build or non-static server not described by this plan, report BLOCKED rather than inventing a passing test.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.prompt: Read docs/feature.md, inspect the resulting UI source and acceptance test, and identify concrete correctness or coverage problems. Do not modify files. A screenshot or successful browser launch alone does not prove the requested behavior.
